entries.zh: 尊位；坐位（按尊卑所居之座次）；地位尊严
entries.en: dignity, rank; seat, place of honor

entries.zh: 位分居上；上等名分（尊长之位）
entries.en: superior dignity; higher rank or station

entries.zh: 府丞（府衙佐贰之官，城中第二等官职）
entries.en: vice-prefect, second dignitary of the prefecture/city
entries.notes: M 栏另出一词 Lsâng 未辨（或为别读），不碍 L/H/R 互证。

entries.zh: 语出肺腑、真心相告（肺腑共尔呾）；肺腑之言
entries.en: to speak heart-to-heart, with truth and sincerity; from the innermost heart
entries.notes: L 词头残缺（Di…da verdad y coraçion）且 H 末字咀/呾存疑；按「肺腑共尔呾＝真心相语」定，故降低置信。

entries.zh: 踌（踌躇）：迟疑不决；暂缓、且置目前
entries.en: to defer for the present; to hesitate, dally
entries.notes: M 栏三音节（tiū tiū hū）与 R 单音节不合，后二音节未辨，义仍依 L/H/R 定为踌躇暂缓。

entries.zh: 悬，悬置不决（迁延时日）；悬挂
entries.en: to suspend, leave pending; to defer for a (later) time; to hang

entries.zh: 延长、延续；延迟（例如延搁时日）
entries.en: to prolong, extend; to delay, put off (e.g. the time)

entries.zh: 传，传述、传播（传述功业事迹）
entries.en: to transmit, spread; to recount, tell (deeds, feats)

entries.zh: 迁缓日子，把时日挨延迁缓（拖延时日）
entries.en: to drag out the days, delay day after day
entries.notes: M 栏末多出 idg 一语未辨（或为例词尾语），主四音节与 R 全合。

entries.zh: 刁难，故意留难（为图利而拖延诉讼、公务）
entries.en: to make difficulties, obstruct deliberately; to drag out a (law)suit for gain

entries.zh: 刁滞，刁难阻滞、有意拖延搁置
entries.en: to obstruct and hold up; to delay wilfully

entries.zh: 踌躇，犹豫不决、迟疑观望
entries.en: to hesitate, waver, dally; to give leeway, put off
to spread one's fame, make a name known

entries.zh: 事悬处，事情悬搁未决之处（悬而未办之事）
entries.en: the matter left pending, unsettled; a deferred business

entries.zh: 悬处，悬搁暂缓、未即办理（稿注又作 hiēn tè 之异读）
entries.en: to leave pending, defer for the present (manuscript gives variant hiēn tè)
entries.notes: 「l.」为稿中「又作/异读」标记（l. hiēn tè），不影响本义。

entries.en: earnest and careful, diligent; steadfast, sincere
entries.notes: M 栏注音处污损难辨（T99），义由 L/H/R（Diligencia & cuidadosa／笃）仍可定，按规则降低置信。

entries.zh: 简，书简、公牍文书（西语 diligencia 于殖民语境亦指公文、所办手续）；简略
entries.en: letter, official document or proceeding (diligencia); brevity, plain/simple
entries.notes: 「简」与 Diligencia 取「书简/公牍」义系推断（diligencia 亦指官署文书手续），非「勤勉」义，故降置信。
